name: FIRSTCALL Programme A - Population A1
definition: The prospectively frozen population of canonical vendor platforms represented by structural entries in the immutable APIs.guru OpenAPI Directory snapshot below, after the frozen structural canonicalisation and designated-key identity rules.
not_a_claim_about: vendors without a listed OpenAPI definition

source.licence: repository CC0-1.0; README: contributed definitions CC0 1.0, definitions acquired from public sources held by APIs.guru under fair use
source.stated_criteria: public (accessible after clearly defined steps), long-lived, useful beyond its owner; private and event-only APIs excluded

snapshot.how_pinned: sole value of refs/heads/main and HEAD returned by `git ls-remote` on 2026-09-18 (ref names and SHAs only; no repository content)
snapshot.rule: A1 uses exactly this commit. At retrieval it must exist and have committer date <= T0 = 2026-09-17T00:00:00Z; otherwise HALT. No other commit, branch, mirror or date may be substituted.
snapshot.expected_vintage: the automated refresh stopped 2024-03-01; later commits 2025-07-17, 2025-08-23 (x2), 2025-08-28, 2026-04-20 (commit dates only)

retrieval.who: registered snapshot custodian (R02), once, after remote anchoring of this amendment
retrieval.method: git fetch of the pinned commit into an empty repository; git clone of the Public Suffix List; a1_frame.py --retrieve
retrieval.exactly_once: output directory created exclusively; a second retrieval is refused
retrieval.psl: https://github.com/publicsuffix/list.git, public_suffix_list.dat at the first first-parent commit of main with committer date <= T0; commit and SHA256 recorded

retained_representation.custody: git bundle of the pinned commit (SHA256 recorded); not republished
retained_representation.published: commit SHA, tree SHA, PSL commit and SHA256, frame.json (K, structural exclusions, component map), raw-entries.json (spec paths and blob ids), retrieval.json
retained_representation.not_published: definition bodies; auditors retrieve them from the public commit

extraction.raw_entry: each file under APIs/<provider>/... whose basename is openapi.json, openapi.yaml, swagger.json or swagger.yaml
extraction.structural_key: NFC + lower-case + trailing-dot removal of the <provider> directory name; no other merge

structural_exclusions.XS2_NO_SPEC_FILE: a provider directory with no spec file

extraction.identity_components: keys grouped by registrable domain (PSL eTLD+1) of the key's host part (text before ':'); keys without a dotted DNS host form singleton components; computed mechanically before the permutation, never adjudicated
extraction.K: byte-sorted unique structural keys; sealed as frame.json with K_sha256 before entropy

conservation: every raw entry maps to exactly one key in K
every key in K has >= 1 raw entry
every top-level entry under APIs/ is either a provider directory in K or a recorded structural exclusion
K is unique and byte-sorted; components partition K
